title: The ALMA-PILS survey: First tentative detection of 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) in the interstellar medium and chemical modeling of the C<SUB>3</SUB>H<SUB>4</SUB>O<SUB>2</SUB> isomers
question: Can 3-hydroxypropenal (HOCHCHCHO) and its C3H4O2 isomers be detected in the solar-type protostar IRAS 16293-2422, and how are they formed chemically?

data.angular_resolution: 0.4 to 0.7 arcsec, restored with a circular beam of 0.5 arcsec

what.value: Spectroscopic data for HOCHCHCHO, C2H3OCHO, C2H3COOH, and CH2OHCH2CH2OH from CDMS

evidence.quote: The spectroscopic data of HOCHCHCHO come from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS, (cite: Muller2001; Muller2005)).
Only C$_2$H$_3$OCHO (vinyl formate) and the s-cis and s-trans conformers of C$_2$H$_3$COOH (propenoic acid) are available in CDMS.

what.value: List of previously identified species in IRAS 16293 B and additional molecules for spectral overlay

evidence.quote: We added HONO (cite: Coutens2019), CH$_3$OCH$_2$OH, CH$_2$DCHO, t-C$_2$H$_5$OCH$_3$ (cite: Manigand2020), C$_2$H$_3$CHO, C$_3$H$_6$ (cite: Manigand2021), and CH$_3$OCHD$_2$ (cite: Richard2021) to the list presented in Appendix A of (cite: Coutens2019).

what.value: Initial abundances and physical model for chemical modeling

evidence.quote: the initial abundances listed in Table 3 of (cite: Manigand2021), and a duration of 10$^6$ years; and ii) the collapse phase described in (cite: Manigand2021).

recipe.goal: Predict molecular presence with a convolutional neural network
recipe.method: Apply a convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on multi-species LTE synthetic spectra to the PILS spectrum at the 0.5 arcsec offset position of IRAS 16293 B
key_parameters: Offset position: alpha_J2000 = 16h32m22.58s, delta_J2000 = -24d28m32.8s (0.5 arcsec SW of continuum peak)

recipe.goal: Identify unblended transitions and fit Gaussian line profiles
recipe.method: Overlay synthetic spectra of previously identified molecules to exclude blended lines, lines with large spectroscopic uncertainties, and lines affected by absorption; fit Gaussians to detected HOCHCHCHO transitions
key_parameters: 11 detected lines >= 20 mJy beam^-1 in Band 7, plus 5 undetected lines with small uncertainties

recipe.goal: Constrain column density and excitation temperature via LTE grid fitting
recipe.method: Generate LTE synthetic spectra over two grids (coarse then fine) of column density N and excitation temperature T_ex, and compute chi-square on unblended and selected undetected lines; also derive upper limits for isomers and 1,3-propanediol
key_parameters: Fine grid: N from 2 x 10^14 to 3 x 10^15 cm^-2 (step 2 x 10^14 cm^-2), T_ex from 50 to 350 K (step 25 K)
Fixed T_ex tests at 125 K and 300 K

recipe.goal: Produce moment 0 maps of HOCHCHCHO transitions
recipe.method: Create integrated intensity (moment 0) maps for three transitions of HOCHCHCHO

recipe.goal: Model chemical evolution of C3H4O2 isomers
recipe.method: Run a three-phase time-dependent astrochemical model using Nautilus with an updated network including six C3H4O2 isomers and DFT-calculated reaction barriers
key_parameters: Pre-stellar stage: density = 5 x 10^4 cm^-3, T_gas = T_dust = 10 K, A_V = 4.5 mag, cosmic-ray ionization rate = 1.3 x 10^-17 s^-1, UV field = 1 G0, duration = 10^6 years; followed by protostellar collapse stage
assumptions: Isomeric ratio approximated by ratio of rovibrational densities of states at the isomerization barrier; barriers and imaginary frequencies calculated at M06-2X/AVTZ DFT level

answer_key.quantity: HOCHCHCHO column density (best-fit at T_ex = 350 K)

evidence.quote: The best-fit model was obtained for a column density $N$ of 2.2 $\times$ 10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ and an excitation temperature $T_{\rm ex}$ of 350 K ($\chi^2_{\rm red}$ $\sim$ 2.0).

If we assume excitation temperatures of 125 and 300 K, we obtain column densities of 3-hydroxypropenal of 1.0 $\times$ 10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ ($\chi^2_{\rm red}$ $\sim$ 2.0) and 1.8 $\times$ 10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ ($\chi^2_{\rm red}$ $\sim$ 2.0), respectively.

If we assume excitation temperatures of 125 and 300 K, we obtain column densities of 3-hydroxypropenal of 1.0 $\times$ 10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ ($\chi^2_{\rm red}$ $\sim$ 2.0) and 1.8 $\times$ 10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ ($\chi^2_{\rm red}$ $\sim$ 2.0), respectively.
Our $\chi^2$ analysis shows that various models with excitation temperatures in the 75–350 K range can properly reproduce the lines included in the calculation (3$\sigma$ uncertainty).

answer_key.quantity: Observed HOCHCHCHO abundance relative to CH3OH

evidence.quote: Based on the observed line intensities and assuming local thermodynamic equilibrium, its column density is constrained to be $\sim$10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$, corresponding to an abundance of 10$^{-4}$ relative to methanol, CH$_3$OH.
| 3-Hydroxypropenal | HOCHCHCHO | 1.4 $\times$ 10$^{-8}$ | 4.6 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ | 1.0 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ |

answer_key.quantity: C2H3OCHO (vinyl formate) column density upper limit

evidence.quote: C$_2$H$_3$OCHO is not detected with an upper limit of 4\,$\times$\,10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ based on the undetected transition at 355.2462 GHz.

answer_key.quantity: s-cis C2H3COOH (propenoic acid) column density upper limit

evidence.quote: Upper limits of 1\,$\times$\,10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ and 4\,$\times$\,10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ are also derived for the s-cis and s-trans conformers of C$_2$H$_3$COOH, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: s-trans C2H3COOH (propenoic acid) column density upper limit

evidence.quote: Upper limits of 1\,$\times$\,10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ and 4\,$\times$\,10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ are also derived for the s-cis and s-trans conformers of C$_2$H$_3$COOH, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: CH2OHCH2CH2OH (1,3-propanediol, conformer a'GG'g) column density upper limit

evidence.quote: The lower energy conformer a’GG’g present in the CDMS database was searched for and an upper limit of 1\,$\times$\,10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$ was derived.

score_reason: The PILS dataset is public, the extraction coordinates, line lists, spectroscopic parameters (CDMS), LTE grid parameters, and new chemical reactions are thoroughly tabulated, though a few inherited parameters (source size, CH3OH reference column density, full Nautilus network file) require consulting companion papers.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA-PILS archival data with exact extraction coordinates, complete line tables, and clear numeric column density targets reproducible via standard LTE spectral fitting (CASSIS).
